message.reasoning_content: Now run acceptance check, and confirm test file unchanged (checksum). Let me check git status / diff.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "cd csvfix && sha256sum test_csvfix.py && git status --porcelain . 2>/dev/null; git -C .. diff --stat -- csvfix/test_csvfix.py 2>/dev/null; echo \"---done---\""}
